title: LOW AT THY PIERCED FEET
stanzas: Low at Thy pierced feet, Saviour of all, Helpless and sorrowful prostrate I fall. O cast me not away, Forgive my sin this day, Forgive my sin this day, Forgive my sin, All, all my sin
Sinful my life hath been, Unclean, unclean, All my iniquity Thine eye hath seen; Cleanse Thou my soul today, Wash all my sins away in Thine own blood in Thine own blood.
By all Thy grief and pain, Forgive me now; Before Thy cross in shame lowly i bow, Lord. let that blood of thine wash now this soul of mine; Wash Thou my soul, Wash Thou my soul.
Lord, I accept Thee now, accept Thou me; I have delayed too long, And grieved Thee, by all thy love to me, I give myself to Thee Make me Thine own, All, All Thine own
